note: BH-9115: hours. When a console-pages deploy run does not deploy (a parked or red npm test, npm ci, vite build or wrangler failed) and main's oldest undeployed console-ui commit is at least this old, bin/console-pages-deploy.sh raises one warn alert --id console-pages-stale; a stamped deploy resolves it. Read as ${CONSOLE_PAGES_STALE_ALERT_H:-}, then this settings row, default 24; 0 = off; a non-number falls through to 24.
